messages:
ellie.design: opened a quick review thread — card header + toolbar spacing, skeleton alignment, and modal CTA sequencing. collecting quick takes before i lock tokens.
max.frontend: looked at the mock. the toolbar actions feel cramped at tablet widths (<= 920px). Suggest collapsing to a kebab earlier.
adrian.foundation: +1. propose new tokens: `gap.card-compact: 8px`, `gap.card-default: 16px`. also `toolbar-action-gap: 8px` for compact.
ellie.design: adding variant notes: when card has 2 line title we should increase top padding to `space.card-lg` so title doesn't touch skeleton.
aria.accessibility: sorry, typo — meant aria.accessibility. focus order concern — if we hide actions into overflow, ensure the overflow button is reachable before modal open. Also add `aria-expanded` to kebab.
max.frontend: implementation note: on collapse we render `<button aria-label="More actions" aria-expanded="false">⋯</button>` and move menu into DOM order after title.
sam.product: cf product decision: primary CTA must never be moved to overflow. If screen narrow, secondary CTAs collapse first.
ellie.design: good call. update prototype to pin primary CTA and demote `ghost` to overflow.
adrian.foundation: also we should reduce skeleton shimmer width from `100%` to `80%` for meta lines to imply shorter text. CSS snippet:
```
.skel-line--meta { width: 80%; height: 12px; margin-top: 6px; }
```
aria.accessibility: toast / modal stacking nit — toasts are currently z-index above modal backdrop which hides dismiss button. toasts should be behind active modal or use `aria-hidden` while modal open.
max.frontend: ack. we'll add rule: `toast.z-index < modal.backdrop.z-index`. also enforce `aria-live="polite"` only when no modal open.
ellie.design: copy tweak: change toast success copy from "Saved" to "Changes saved" to avoid ambiguous tense for screen readers.
design-bot: added design task D-431 to track token changes and accessibility checklist.
sam.product: timeline? we'd like this in next sprint if it's just token + tiny CSS.
max.frontend: can do a small PR for tokens + skeleton + toast z-index; will need design review on the demo.
ellie.design: cool — i'll post updated tokens & prototype later today. thanks all :rocket:
